intro: A Bottle of Moonshine is a potent alcoholic spirit sold in the gloomy settlement of Darkshire. Barkeep Daniels of Lakeshire urgently seeks a bottle to help restock the town tavern as Blackrock orc incursions cut off regular supply shipments.

p: Lakeshire stands besieged by the Blackrock clan, leaving its local innkeeper, Barkeep Daniels, in dire straits as regular supply caravans fail to arrive. To keep up morale among the town guards and beleaguered townsfolk, Daniels sends couriers across the southern kingdoms to gather regional specialties. Among these is a potent bottle of moonshine brewed and sold at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in neighboring Duskwood, where locals favor stiff drinks to ward off the encroaching dread of the woods.
